name: Halation
desc: A photochemical pass that carries its own light: scattered gate flares and a soft light leak wander the frame on incommensurate drifts, light blooms warm back off the film base around every highlight beneath, a warm veil fogs the plate, and silver grain sits in the midtones where the emulsion actually is — with bleach-bypass, cross-process and infrared stocks in the same magazine.

energy.doc: strength of all the intrinsic light — flares, leak and veil together

scale.doc: size of the flares, the leak bar and the halation radius

bloom.doc: how far light scatters back off the film base, and how big the gate flares grow

grain.doc: silver halide grain — overlay in the midtones plus a whisper of additive silver so the shadows are not dead flat

hue.doc: halation hue (18 = the warm red-orange of a real film base)

speed.doc: how fast the flares and the leak wander

x.doc: centre the flares wander about, x

y.doc: centre the flares wander about, y

style.doc: halation: warm bloom off the film base · bleach: bleach-bypass, silver retained, desaturated and gritty · cross_process: E6 in C41, crushed shifting colour · infrared: false-colour IR, foliage goes white-hot

act.doc: expose: steady · flare: the gate blooms hard with the section arc · decay: the stock ages, grain and fog breathing over minutes

seed.doc: deterministic seed — flare placement and grain
